creative_direction: Create a small bird from bent brushed-aluminum plates, standing on one thin ring-shaped support. Show the brushed grain changing direction between plates, tiny folded seams, and restrained blue reflections along the metal edges. The ring stand should be clearly separate from the bird body and keep the sculpture compact. Place it against warm ivory with one crisp shadow. Center the object inside the safe circular region of a square avatar, with no bolts spilling outward or industrial background.
